text: Hello, neighbours! I keep bees, so I've a soft spot for the apple trees in the orchard. Every spring the blossoms hum with my little workers, and the apples in autumn are their thank-you gift. A good orchard and a good hive really do need each other.
speaker: ada

text: Um... hello. I'm Bo. I like the pond when it's quiet, because the water hums back whatever tune I play. Sometimes I bring my little instrument down to the eastern shore and just let the ripples keep time. I think it listens better than most people... thank you for listening too.
speaker: bo
